notes.provenance: Transcribed from the supplied TROPHY_SOURCE_NOTES.txt, dated November 18, 2026. No independent verification or live data is used.
notes.descriptions: Only entries explicitly labeled Official description in the notes are marked official. Other descriptions reproduce the supplied unlock condition and are labeled source-condition rather than inventing official wording.
notes.hidden: The notes say about 28 trophies are hidden but do not identify each one. The 28 hidden flags are conservative editorial spoiler protection, not a verified platform hidden list.
notes.missable: Positive Mental Attitude is potentially missable; the notes do not confirm whether the Chapter 1 meditation is mandatory.
notes.points: The 54 numerical rewards in the notes sum to 1,000G. The platinum equivalent is a Mythic Achievement with no numerical G specified, recorded as 0.
notes.rarity: Colors indicate trophy tier. Player unlock percentages are unavailable, so no rarity statistics are fabricated.

gta-guide.name: gta.guide
gta-guide.context: Trophy conditions and guide details reproduced in the supplied source notes.

gtabase.name: GTABase
gtabase.context: Attributed in the notes for the approximately 200-hour estimate and absence of mission replay, difficulty selection, and New Game+.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.description: Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies on this checklist. The platinum is the final reward for the full set.
Use A Long Road as your completion checklist, then finish trophy-specific targets that sit outside that checklist.
Protect your Chapter 1 meditation opportunity and keep cheats disabled throughout the run.
trophies.uncertainty: The roughly 200-hour estimate is attributed to GTABase in the notes; it is not a guaranteed completion time.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.description: Complete the Gone Fishing mission
steps: Follow the opening Chapter 1 story missions until Gone Fishing becomes available.
Complete Gone Fishing. This is a required early story mission and the notes identify the trophy as unmissable.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 1
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 story arc.
Continue into Chapter 2 and complete What's in the Bag? The notes place the actual unlock after this mission, rather than at the chapter transition.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 2
steps: Work through the required missions in Chapter 2.
Finish Welcome to Vice City at the start of Chapter 3 to trigger the trophy. The masked name is preserved as supplied in the notes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 3
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 main story.
Play Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two missions in Chapter 4. The notes say the trophy unlocks after both are finished.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 4
steps: Follow the main mission chain through Chapter 4.
Finish the chapter. The supplied notes do not specify a further mission or delayed trigger for this unlock.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.description: Complete the final mission
steps: Finish the remaining main story missions and complete the finale.
After the credits, return to free roam to finish activities, collections, and other outstanding trophies.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.description: Complete the Breakfast Run mission
steps: Advance the Chapter 2 story until Breakfast Run is available.
Complete that mission to earn the trophy; no additional challenge is specified.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.description: Complete The Cartel Heist mission
steps: Progress through Chapter 3 to The Cartel Heist.
Complete the heist as part of the main mission chain.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.description: Complete the Child's Play mission
steps: Continue the Chapter 4 story until Child's Play.
Finish the mission to unlock this story reward.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.description: Complete the Headliners mission
steps: Reach Headliners during Chapter 4.
Finish its story objectives. No separate performance requirement is listed in the notes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.description: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission
steps: Advance to VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission. This trophy follows the story rather than a separate airport free-roam action.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.description: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission
steps: Play through Chapter 5 until Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the mission to earn the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.description: Reach 100% completion
steps: After the story, open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion. Earlier progress already counts; the notes say the completion checklist itself has no missable requirements.
Finish all 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range gold medals, 42 drone races, and Bret's 15 hunting tasks.
Reach the partial-category targets too: 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, and 200 vehicle models.
Use the in-game checklist for any remaining requirements. The supplied notes give examples rather than an exhaustive breakdown of every category.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.description: Complete 250 stunts
steps: Complete any mixture of stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife-edge flights, and base jumps.
Reach 250 out of the 397 available stunts. Under-bridge flights are the notes' suggested fast route.
Continue to 300 stunts if you are also working on 100% completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Do each kind of activity at least once
steps: Try fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, and pool.
Make one basketball shot, play an arcade game, win a race, and complete a stunt.
Check off all nine activity types; repeating one activity does not replace another type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Get gold in every shooting range challenge
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges and complete their challenges.
Improve each result to gold until you have all 42 gold medals.
Range practice also builds Focus, so combine it with preparation for Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun drone race in each of the locations
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone-racing locations.
Win one race at every location to meet this trophy's requirement.
For A Long Road, return and win all 42 drone races rather than stopping at 14 wins.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.description: Win 20 different races
steps: Choose races from the 40 available events.
Record a win in 20 distinct races. Repeating a race you have already won does not raise this total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Win a fishing challenge against Cal
steps: Meet Cal during Feng Shui in Chapter 1.
Follow the fishing-spot text he sends and work through his fishing quests.
Beat Cal when his fishing challenge becomes available.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.description: Complete an arcade game
steps: Choose Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, or Time Jackers Rewind on your home TV, or find a Bang For Your Buck arcade cabinet.
Finish any one of those games. Simply starting a game is not the stated requirement.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and respond to Andy's text.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, and Read the Label.
Finish Puff Puff Pass, the fifth and final job in Andy's chain.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton
steps: Take Kenton's treasure-recovery job in Chapter 1.
Dive at the purple shipwreck markers and use the metal detector to recover treasure from all seven wrecks.
Wait for Kenton's later text and finish the follow-up to close his mission chain.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy
steps: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2 and visit the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Complete Billy's five jobs in sequence.
Finish Hometown Heroes, the fifth job, for the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across the State of Leonida
steps: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission chains and watch the platform trophy counter.
The notes identify Kirk, Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete as examples that count.
Do not rely on Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, or Eddie for this total; their chains are excluded in the notes.
trophies.uncertainty: The complete list of qualifying stranger chains is still unconfirmed in the source.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy
steps: Use Randy's requested-car list to identify the 16 sports cars he wants.
Scan vehicles in the WAiNK app to check whether they are on his list.
Deliver all 16 to his garage in western Vice City and finish the chain.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone
steps: Play as Jason and complete Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Take Tyrone's jobs to destroy the synthetic labs around Vice City.
Complete Shut Down the Labs to finish Tyrone's chain.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida
steps: In Chapter 1, accept Lucia's balcony meditation invitation on the morning after Down to Earth. Take this opportunity before advancing.
Continue visiting meditation spots across Leonida until the counter reaches 18.
Meditating with both Jason and Lucia counts twice according to the notes. The 100% checklist only needs 15 meditations, so keep going for this trophy.
trophies.whenMissed: Potentially missable in Chapter 1: skipping Lucia's balcony invitation the morning after Down to Earth may prevent this trophy. Accept it before continuing the story; keep a separate save beforehand if possible.
trophies.uncertainty: The source has not confirmed whether the balcony meditation is required. Treat this as a precaution, not a confirmed permanent lockout.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret
steps: Complete Coffee Break in Chapter 2 to open Bret's hunting jobs.
Work through the hunting assignments and take the requested unique animal.
If pursuing platinum, complete all 15 jobs for the 100% checklist regardless of when this trophy unlocks.
trophies.uncertainty: The notes do not identify the exact animal that triggers the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.description: Collect 3 sets of collectible cards
steps: Open Progress → Collections to inspect your card sets.
Find the remaining cards in any three sets. The notes do not require three particular sets.
Finish all cards within each selected set and confirm three completed sets in Collections.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.description: Use WAiNK It in 100 locations
steps: Use WAiNK It while exploring landmarks, oddities, sculptures, and No Flusher graffiti.
Register 100 different eligible locations. Any mix of these location types counts.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.description: Complete 50 challenges
steps: Track challenges as you play; many of the 80 available challenges will finish naturally.
Complete 50 for this trophy, then work toward 70 if pursuing 100% completion.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Escape a 4-star wanted level together with your partner
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner and travel together.
Build a four-star wanted level. A bank vault robbery is one way to guarantee four stars.
Escape with your partner and leave the red zone completely; merely breaking line of sight is not enough.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 stores in a row together with your partner without losing your wanted level
steps: Bring your partner and plan a short route linking three shops; the notes suggest the three jewelry stores in northern Vice City.
Rob all three back-to-back while keeping your wanted level active between robberies.
Allow roughly 30 seconds for the trophy notification, since the notes report a possible delay.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.description: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app
steps: Stand beside a busy road and use WAiNK to scan passing vehicle models; stealing them is unnecessary.
Reach 100 different models for the trophy.
Keep scanning toward 200 models for the 100% completion requirement.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Kill 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus
steps: Fill the Focus meter and equip an assault rifle before starting a fight.
Find a group of enemies close together; gang operations are the suggested opportunity.
Activate Combat Focus once and defeat five enemies before that activation ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Perform an unplanned takeoff from VCIA
steps: At VCIA, look for a large passenger aircraft parked at a gate with a jet bridge.
Steal the aircraft and take off.
Fly approximately one kilometer away from the airport to satisfy the departure described in the notes.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.description: Kinda hot in these Rhinos
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station on the southwestern island of Mariana County.
Look along the southern edge of the base for parked tanks and steal one.
Use the stolen tank to defeat enemies. The notes do not specify a required number.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store while remaining undetected
steps: Complete Yasmani's Chapter 3 missions until you receive the Snap Gun.
Use it to open a jewelry store's back door quietly.
Find the safe-code note in the storeroom, open the safe, and complete the robbery without detection.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.description: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away
steps: Complete the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock bank vaults.
Rob five vaults and successfully escape after each. Bring a partner if you want to split the loot.
Finish all eight vaults when working toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an armored truck and get away
steps: Find an armored truck and use a sticky bomb to open it, then take the money and escape.
Alternatively, the notes report that robbing a bank vault and escaping can also trigger this trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.description: Explore all of Leonida
steps: Travel over the whole map to remove its fog of war.
Use a plane to cover large areas quickly and revisit any patches still obscured on the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang
steps: Find and rob at least one illegal operation controlled by each of the nine gangs.
Make sure you visit all nine gangs rather than repeating operations for a single gang.
For 100% completion, continue until all 39 operations are finished.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view of Ocean Beach
steps: The stated objective is to enjoy a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach.
The supplied notes do not identify the exact venue or interaction. Keep this unchecked until you see the in-game unlock.
trophies.uncertainty: Exact unlock steps are not yet confirmed in the source.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style
steps: The source condition is to drive a car out of a vehicle showroom through its display window.
Use the in-game notification to confirm completion; the notes do not name a specific showroom or provide tested steps.
trophies.uncertainty: The condition is supplied, but the exact execution is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
steps: The source guide directs you to rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Collect the watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, and the safe's valuables.
Escape the police after the robbery. The official description uses the different venue name Kolt & Associates.
trophies.uncertainty: The guide's venue name and the supplied official description differ; both are retained rather than silently reconciled.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.description: A partnership with mass appeal
steps: Bring your partner to a fitness club and train Strength.
Training one character also improves the other's Strength according to the notes.
Continue until both characters have reached maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.description: Choices made (for better or worse)
steps: Accumulate 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile as you play.
Let ordinary play contribute instead of pushing your profile to Irredeemable; the notes warn that this profile state is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.description: Second time's the charm
steps: The supplied source does not disclose the unlock condition.
No reliable sequence of actions can be derived from the description alone. Leave this trophy pending until the in-game unlock or a confirmed method is available.
trophies.uncertainty: Unlock condition and steps are undisclosed. No second-attempt mechanic is assumed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.description: What the hell just happened?
steps: The supplied source leaves this trophy's condition undisclosed.
Use an actual in-game unlock as confirmation. The description alone does not establish an encounter, location, or required action.
trophies.uncertainty: Unlock condition and steps are not confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by
steps: The supplied description points to a melee drive-by.
The source does not confirm the vehicle, target count, or exact input sequence. Avoid treating any specific setup as a verified solution.
trophies.uncertainty: A melee drive-by is indicated, but tested unlock steps are unavailable.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through contacts
steps: Obtain the Dye Pack Jammer during Chapter 3.
Collect marked bills from banks and Payday Loans robberies, then sell them to fences. Yasmani is the notes' recommended buyer for the highest payout.
Launder $250,000 in total; this is cumulative and does not need to be earned in a single sale.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.description: Spend $100,000 across all stores in total
steps: Spend money at shops until your combined purchases reach $100,000.
Weapons, vehicle customization, and tattoos are suggested ways to build the total while buying useful items.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.description: Buy all garages
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Purchase all eight buyable garages, budgeting approximately $160,000 in total.
The four garages awarded by the story do not count toward these eight purchases.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app
steps: Complete Moses' Chapter 2 mission to obtain the Scooter Bros app.
Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn and pay to register them.
Register ten vehicles. Keep garage space available and use inexpensive cars or bikes to reduce the registration cost.
